sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.text_preview: `Svc::ComQueue` is an  F´ active component that functions as a priority queue of buffer types. Messages are dequeued and forwarded in order of priority when a `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal is received

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
sections.text_preview:

2. Data is considered to be successfully sent when a `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal is received in response to that data

sections.title: 4.5.3 comStatusIn
sections.text_preview:
The `comStatusIn` port handler receives a `Fw::Success` status. This triggers the component's state machine to change
state. For a full description see [4.2.1 State Machine](#4.2.1-State-Machine).

1. Report the high-water mark for each queue since last `run` invocation via telemetry

sections.title: 4.9.1 sendComBuffer
sections.text_preview: Stores the com buffer message, sends the com buffer message on the output port, and then sets the send state to waiting.

sections.title: 4.9.2 sendBuffer
sections.text_preview: Stores the buffer message, sends the buffer message on the output port, and then sets the send state to waiting.

sections.title: 4.9.3 processQueue

sections.title: 4.9.4 enqueue
sections.text_preview: Attempts to enqueue the buffer onto the queue index, logs a (throttled) warning if data is discarded, and immediately processes the queue if state is `READY`.

sections.title: 4.9.5 drainQueue
sections.text_preview: Pops all messages out of the queue at queueIndex, `index`.

sections.title: 4.9.6 getQueueNum
sections.text_preview: Converts a `queueType` & `portNum` into an index into the `m_queues` array--translates between user facing index system & internal one.
